knowledge:
- key_parameters: celFiles=Character vector of paths to raw CEL files ;; batch=Character vector indicating processing batches (e.g., chemistry plates or scan dates); copy number estimation requires at least 10 samples per batch ;; cdfName=Name of the annotation package without the "Crlmm" suffix (e.g., "genomewidesnp6") ;; genome=Character string specifying the genome build (e.g., "hg19") ;; gender=If NULL, gender is automatically imputed from X and Y chromosome intensities ;; outdir/ldPath=Directory path where large ff disk-backed objects are stored to manage RAM ;; ocProbesets/ocSamples=Functions to set the maximum number of probesets and samples to keep in active RAM
- alternatives: oligo=Previous implementation of CRLMM; crlmm is preferred as it is faster, avoids SQL queries by using simple R objects, and provides improved confidence/quality scores ;; VanillaICE=Preferred for downstream hidden Markov models (HMM) using log R ratios and B allele frequencies ;; snpStats=Preferred for downstream genome-wide association studies (GWAS) using SnpMatrix objects
- when_to_use: Use when you need to perform high-throughput genotyping, quality control (SNR), and copy number estimation (including allele-specific copy number, log R ratios, and B allele frequencies) from raw Affymetrix or Illumina microarray data.
- pitfalls: Segment faults during normalization are often caused by corrupt CEL files; use validCEL(celFiles) to verify file integrity ;; Copy number estimation requires at least 10 samples per batch; smaller batches (< 50) yield noisy estimates ;; Low SNR values (below 5 for Affymetrix, below 25 for Illumina) indicate poor sample quality and may require excluding those samples ;; Large datasets can easily exhaust RAM; ensure ldPath() is set to store ff objects on disk and use ocProbesets() / ocSamples() to manage memory.

workflows.name: simple_genotyping
workflows.intent: Genotype Affymetrix CEL files quickly using the basic CRLMM algorithm to obtain genotype calls and confidence scores.
input: celFiles (vector of paths to raw Affymetrix CEL files)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify CEL files ;; 2. Run the crlmm function ;; 3. Extract genotype calls, confidence scores, and SNR.
workflows.code:
require(oligoClasses)
library(crlmm)
library(hapmapsnp6)
path <- system.file("celFiles", package="hapmapsnp6")
celFiles <- list.celfiles(path, full.names=TRUE)
system.time(crlmmResult <- crlmm(celFiles, verbose=FALSE))
calls(crlmmResult)[1:10,]
confs(crlmmResult)[1:10,]
crlmmResult[["SNR"]]

workflows.name: copy_number_and_genotyping_pipeline
workflows.intent: Preprocess, genotype, and estimate copy number (including allele-specific copy number, log R ratios, and B allele frequencies) using a disk-backed CNSet container.
input: celFiles (vector of paths to raw Affymetrix CEL files)
workflows.stages: 1. Set up disk-backed storage and RAM limits ;; 2. Construct the CNSet container ;; 3. Perform quantile normalization ;; 4. Genotype and impute gender ;; 5. Fit linear model for copy number ;; 6. Extract raw copy number or coerce to BafLrrSetList for log R ratios and B allele frequencies.
workflows.code:
library(oligoClasses)
library(crlmm)
library(ff)
outdir <- paste("/local_data/r00/crlmm/", getRversion(), "/affy_vignette", sep="")
ldPath(outdir)
ocProbesets(100000)
ocSamples(200)
celFiles <- list.celfiles(pathToCels, full.names=TRUE, pattern=".CEL")[1:10]
plates <- substr(basename(celFiles), 13, 13)
cnSet <- constructAffyCNSet(celFiles, batch=plates, cdfName="genomewidesnp6", genome="hg19")
cnrmaAffy(cnSet)
validCEL(celFiles)
snprmaAffy(cnSet)
genotypeAffy(cnSet, gender=NULL)
table(c("male", "female")[cnSet$gender[]])
crlmmCopynumber(cnSet)
tmp <- totalCopynumber(cnSet, i=seq_len(nrow(cnSet)), j=1:2)
snp.index <- which(isSnp(cnSet) & !is.na(chromosome(cnSet)))
ca <- CA(cnSet, i=snp.index, j=1:2)
cb <- CB(cnSet, i=snp.index, j=1:2)
library(VanillaICE)
open(cnSet)
oligoSetList <- BafLrrSetList(cnSet)
close(cnSet)
lrrList <- lrr(oligoSetList)
bafList <- baf(oligoSetList)

workflows.name: gwas_preparation_with_snpstats
workflows.intent: Convert CRLMM genotype calls to a SnpMatrix for downstream GWAS analysis using the snpStats package.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract and recode genotype calls ;; 2. Filter out non-informative SNPs ;; 3. Convert to SnpMatrix ;; 4. Perform association testing.
workflows.code:
theCalls <- t(calls(crlmmResult))-1L
rm(crlmmResult)
gtypeCounts <- rbind(AA=colSums(theCalls == 0L), AB=colSums(theCalls == 1L), BB=colSums(theCalls == 2L))
toRemove <- which(colSums(gtypeCounts == 0) == 2L)
theCalls <- theCalls[, -toRemove]
library(snpStats)
crlmmSM <- new("SnpMatrix", theCalls)
ex <- as.numeric(exprs(hmceuB36)[mypr[1],])
subjdata <- pData(hmceuB36)
subjdata[["ex"]] <- ex
gwas <- snp.rhs.tests(ex~male, data=subjdata, snp.data=crlmmSM, family="gaussian")
